lines.t:
A trap-like <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c> that activates on a specific <c:ffff00>act<c> by
the {{opponent}}. Placed on the <c:ffff00>{{field}}<c>, mostly by <c:ffff00>Set-up<c>
<c:ffff00>skill<c> <c:ffff00>actions<c>. One type per team; setting another
replaces it.
Its <c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> starts at 100 and drops by 50 per
activation. It can't be <c:ffff00>recovered<c>, but setting the
same type again raises it by 50 (max 300); below
100 it returns to 100.
Some types change {{effect}} by {{armor}}.
